steps.label: docker
steps.cmd: apt-get update && apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2

steps.label: up
steps.cmd: docker rm -f spawnables-langflow >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --restart unless-stopped --name spawnables-langflow -p 7860:7860 -v /opt/spawnables-services/langflow:/app/data langflowai/langflow:latest

notes: visual builder for llm flows (python fastapi under the hood). runs with sqlite by default so a single container is honest here; pointing it at postgres is a compose change, not a promise. this is the low-code lane next to n8n's integration lane.
